top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two distinct, mechanistically defined achievements within the three-laureate limit: Crews and Deshaies for conceiving and first demonstrating heterobifunctional degraders (a designed, proximity-induced ubiquitination reaction confirmed by ternary-complex structures and independent groups), and Liu alone for base editing (an engineered, evolved deaminase acting on a DNA base, with the cleanest attribution on the list). The citation separates the original concept from later refinement, though the omission of Ciulli, Handa and Sakamoto and the absence of an approved degrader remain real costs.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Zou Xiaodong is a Stockholm University colleague but is not a candidate under any proposal
